review.custodian: Prefeitura de Mossoró municipal planning GIS publication; local municipal map evidence found.
review.scope: The qgis.mossoro.rn.gov.br public QGIS2Web page references a LOTES layer. Anonymous GET of /data/LOTES_2.js returned an embedded GeoJSON FeatureCollection with 102712 MultiPolygon features and CRS84.
review.pointCheck: Using the exact WUP point [-5.18781240816959, -37.3469601198617] as latitude/longitude, two lot feature bounding boxes included the point: idlote 18205/objectid 51175 and idlote 97137/objectid 144786. This is bounded candidate evidence, not a citywide claim.
review.schema: Safe inspected fields: idlote, objectid, geometry. The source also exposes other attributes, which were not retained or requested for qualification.
review.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key used. The source's idlote field is recorded as the preferred native identity; objectid is retained only as source schema evidence.
review.sampleDecision: No retained GeoJSON sample: full source geometry was inspected in ignored scratch only; retaining zero polygons avoids copying the large static export and avoids implying independently qualified runtime coverage.
review.runtimeDecision: Held. Static public export is useful source evidence but has no qualified bounded query, update, or pagination semantics. Serial review required before adapter admission.

requests.outcome: QGIS2Web HTML retrieved; LOTES_2.js data asset reference identified; no login wall.
75893116-byte JavaScript-wrapped GeoJSON retrieved; 102712 features; CRS84; MultiPolygon lot geometries.
Municipal map page retrieved; general location search/map UI observed, but no parcel API was identified from the page.
Municipal planning map/document portal reviewed; CTM and georeferenced planning evidence recorded, not treated as parcel geometry.
Official municipal publication reviewed; says georeferenced REURB surveys feed the municipal CTM, but this is procedural evidence, not a parcel endpoint.

uncertainty: Static export update cadence and legal cadastral status are unknown.
Bounding-box inclusion is not a point-in-polygon result.
Transport success does not prove complete citywide coverage.
Runtime readiness is intentionally held pending serial adapter qualification.
